name: Corporal Punishment
caption: A former marine turned heel who founded the Third World Order stable to challenge the SWF's established champion cliques.

name: Deaf Leopard
caption: A washed-up rock guitarist turned SWF heel, recruited into the Third World Order by Corporal Punishment.

tenures.source: the site's own biography page for this wrestler (dleopard.html)

name: Pagan
caption: A globe-touring heel who debuted at the SWF on 28 June 1997 and held the American Championship three times across the wing's run.

name: Mr. Shhh
caption: A World and American Champion who rose through the stables Trinity, The Gangstas and The Church of Pain before the site's own final roster billed him as the SWF's retired owner and acting president.
